title: Public SEO and Admin search keywords
summary: Public pages get unique UK English titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, and canonical URLs. Signed-in and Admin pages stay out of search indexes. Admin shell search finds plugins and sections by synonym (for example jobs, helpdesk, permissions).
changes: Add lang/en_GB/seo.php and an SEO layout component for titles, descriptions, Open Graph, canonical URLs, and html lang=en-GB.
Serve /robots.txt that disallows staff paths and /sitemap.xml that lists public pages plus open Recruitment roles only.
Add permission-gated Admin search powered by plugin searchKeywordsKey synonyms and Core admin.search.keywords.* lists.
Expand Recruitment, Tickets, Cases, Consultations, and Pet Profiles keyword lists; document searchKeywordsKey on the plugin settings contract.
affected_areas: Public SEO meta and recruitment Open roles
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: public SEO and Admin keyword search after APES CIC staff string extraction (0.38.7).
validation: PHPUnit PublicSeoTest, AdminSearchKeywordsTest, PublicChromeNamingTest, and related Admin/plugin suites.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Sidebar and footer still show MyAPES Core chrome labels; SEO titles and Open Graph use MyAPES Account per the glossary.
User locale preference and CI hard-fail for missing keys remain for Wave 4 (#275, #276).
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Public SEO and Admin search return to the prior generic meta and no Admin keyword filter; no database migrations are included.
